plugins.name: agent-comms
plugins.description: Main/subagent real-time comms for ZCode: bundled worker (full-tools executor) and scout (read-only recon) agent types with reporting protocol baked into their system prompts, plus open_channel/report/wait_worker_event/read_events MCP tools (wait-any-worker, silence detection, auditable anchor artifacts).

description_i18n.en: Real-time main/subagent communication: bundled worker (full-tools executor) and scout (read-only recon) types with the reporting protocol baked in, plus wait-any-worker MCP tool with timeout summaries.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 主/子代理实时互通：worker（全工具执行型）与 scout（只读核查型）自带三层边界汇报协议，配套 open_channel/report/wait_worker_event/read_events 工具实现任意 worker 聚合等待、沉默检测与锚工件审计。
